source: https://nepaliport.immigration.gov.np/on-arrival/tourist-visa live first screen and its current JavaScript labels, plus https://immigration.gov.np/visa-information and https://cn.nepalembassy.gov.np/pages/visa/, read 2026-08-30. The public pages expose the preparation items below but no readable text-field regexes, character limits or official validation error strings, so no pattern or maxLength is claimed and no local validator is mounted.

visa_route.label: Visa route and on-arrival eligibility
visa_route.placeholder: Visa on arrival, ETA or mission visa
visa_route.help: Most eligible tourists can use visa on arrival and pre-fill the online form. Indian citizens do not need a visa. Twelve listed nationalities and travel-document holders must arrange a visa in advance.

entry_point.label: Entry point
entry_point.placeholder: The port where you will enter Nepal
entry_point.help: The online flow starts by asking for the entry point. Choose the airport or land office where the immigration officer will issue the visa.

passport_country.label: Passport-issuing country
passport_country.help: NepaliPort uses the passport-issuing country to determine the route and fee treatment, including gratis categories.

passport_number.label: Passport number
passport_number.placeholder: From the passport used for travel
passport_number.help: Use the passport that will be presented at the immigration desk.

date_of_birth.label: Date of birth (AD)
date_of_birth.placeholder: Use the official day, month and year controls
date_of_birth.help: The live first screen asks for Date of Birth (AD) with separate day, month and year choices.

full_name.label: Full name
full_name.placeholder: Exactly as shown in the passport
full_name.help: The Department tells applicants to make every detail match the passport.

passport_validity.label: Passport validity
passport_validity.help: The Nepal Embassy in Beijing says the passport should remain valid for more than six months for visa processing.

digital_photo.label: Recent digital photograph
digital_photo.help: The official online guidance asks applicants to prepare a recent digital photograph.

addresses.label: Permanent address and address in Nepal
addresses.placeholder: Full home address and hotel or local address
addresses.help: Prepare a detailed permanent residence address and the detailed address where you will stay in Nepal.

contact_and_duration.label: Contact details and visa duration
contact_and_duration.help: The official guidance asks for telephone numbers and email. Select the intended Tourist Visa duration before payment.
